comments.content: Manual PATH fallback does not apply Windows PATHEXT / executable extensions and does not short-circuit when sshCommand is already fully qualified. On Windows 'ssh' will not match 'ssh.exe', and Path.Combine(path, sshCommand) will produce an invalid path if sshCommand is an absolute path, leading to a false CommandNotFoundException. Consider checking Path.IsPathFullyQualified(sshCommand) first and trying PATHEXT extensions, and on Unix verify executable permission rather than just File.Exists.
